subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw define a core session-level process/step event contract, and if so what taxonomy, replay, authorization, and redaction guarantees should it expose?
rationale: This is not a narrow bug fix; it creates a new core event contract and security boundary that clients may depend on across releases.

options.title: Design one core contract
options.body: Approve a small design pass for the process/step taxonomy, replay model, ordering, authorization, and redaction rules before implementation.

options.title: Use existing streams
options.body: Keep item/plan/tool/lifecycle/session.tool as the supported model and document which client surfaces should consume each stream.

options.title: Narrow to downstream surfaces
options.body: Split the remaining UX needs into separate Control UI, CLI, or inter-session progress issues and avoid a generic process-event API for now.

recommendation.title: Design one core contract
recommendation.body: Approve a small design pass for the process/step taxonomy, replay model, ordering, authorization, and redaction rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice touches the central agent event contract where steipete has recent adjacent structured event history.
